hld.executive_summary: High-Reliability Fintech Payment Processing Engine System is designed as an enterprise-grade Modular Monolith architecture for Financial Services & Banking. The system isolates core domain workflows into resilient, independently deployable services backed by PostgreSQL 16 and Redis 7.2 Cluster.
business_goals: Achieve 99.9% system availability for Financial Services & Banking operations.
Ensure sub-250ms p95 response time under concurrent user load.
Enforce strict transaction consistency and data auditability.

major_services.name: Auth & KYC Service
major_services.responsibility: Handles core domain transactions and workflows for auth & kyc service.

major_services.name: Account & Ledger Service
major_services.responsibility: Handles core domain transactions and workflows for account & ledger service.

major_services.name: Payment Transfer Service
major_services.responsibility: Handles core domain transactions and workflows for payment transfer service.

major_services.name: Fraud & Risk Service
major_services.responsibility: Handles core domain transactions and workflows for fraud & risk service.

major_services.name: Statement & Analytics Service
major_services.responsibility: Handles core domain transactions and workflows for statement & analytics service.

communication_patterns.usage: Client-to-Gateway and Gateway-to-Core Service request-response APIs
Domain event notification reminders, transaction history audits, and background tasks
communication_patterns.resilience: Dead-letter exchange with exponential retry backoff (3 attempts)

data_strategy.replication: Primary-Replica configuration with automated failover and read-replica offloading
data_strategy.backup_policy: Point-in-Time Recovery (PITR) with continuous WAL archiving and daily full snapshots

security_overview.authentication: Stateless JWT access tokens with Redis-backed refresh token rotation
security_overview.authorization: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) enforced at API Gateway and Service boundary
security_overview.data_protection: AES-256 encryption at rest, TLS 1.3 encryption in transit
security_overview.audit_logging: Immutable audit log trail for all administrative and modification transactions

deployment_strategy.ingress: Ingress-NGINX with TLS Termination and Rate Limiting
deployment_strategy.ci_cd: GitHub Actions automated build, container vulnerability scan, and rolling deployment
deployment_strategy.monitoring: Prometheus metrics, Grafana dashboards, OpenTelemetry distributed tracing

decisions.title: Adoption of Modular Monolith for High-Reliability Fintech Payment Processing Engine System
decisions.rationale: Provides optimal balance of modular boundary isolation, fast iteration, and manageable operational complexity for Financial Services & Banking.

decisions.title: Dual-Layer Caching and Read-Replica Offloading
decisions.rationale: Guarantees p95 read latency under 150ms while insulating primary transactional database from high-volume queries.

diagrams.title: High-Reliability Fintech Payment Processing Engine System Container Architecture
diagrams.description: Visualizes client apps, API gateway, microservices, databases, and message queues.

rag_metadata.query: Enterprise technology stack selection matrix, Software Application, framework comparison (FastAPI, Spring Boot, Node.js), database evaluation SQL vs NoSQL (PostgreSQL, MongoDB), caching layers (Redis), and cloud hosting trade-offs for

backend.reasoning: Asynchronous high-performance framework with native OpenAPI schema generation and typed Pydantic data validation.

frontend.reasoning: Component modularity, server-side rendering for catalog search performance, and rich ecosystem.

database.reasoning: ACID compliance for critical domain workflows, row-level locking for transactional state concurrency, and JSONB support.

cache.reasoning: High-throughput in-memory caching for low-latency search queries and distributed session state.

authentication.selected_option: OAuth2 with Authorization Code Flow & PKCE (JWT RS256)
authentication.reasoning: Stateless token authorization, fine-grained role-based access control (RBAC), and zero plain-text token exposure.

communication.selected_option: RESTful JSON APIs over HTTP/2 & WebSockets
communication.reasoning: Standardized HTTP semantics for CRUD operations with WebSocket channels for real-time notifications.

cloud.reasoning: Serverless container orchestration eliminating OS management overhead with automated Multi-AZ database backups.

deployment.selected_option: Docker Multi-Stage Builds with GitHub Actions CI/CD
deployment.reasoning: Reproducible immutable container artifacts with automated linting, test gating, and zero-downtime deployment.

rationale: PostgreSQL guarantees transactional consistency and ACID integrity for  operations.
FastAPI and Redis ensure sub-250ms p95 API response times under concurrent load.
OAuth2 PKCE and JWT provide robust role-based access control for administrative and standard users.

rag_metadata.query: High Level System Design patterns, Modular Monolith, domain module boundary decomposition, synchronous REST vs asynchronous message bus communication, API gateway topology, distributed caching strategies (Redis), and high availability architecture for Financial Services & Banking
